worker.scope: Local workerd, real strict Worker bundles, synthetic canonical wallet key, typed Gateway owner admission, and durable signing. Verified factor inputs, claimed-operation persistence, and custody activation are injected. HTTP login, public session routes, and hosted latency remain outside this test.

terminalFailures.scope: Public Gateway/SDK with WebAuthn and real Worker admission, paired material consumption, completion, and exact replay. Terminal causes are injected at the authenticated completion boundary. Cryptographic rejection is not simulated as a successful signature.

sourceReview.scope: Bounded review of failed data/ACK writes, close-event draining, deadlines, and final-result failure mapping.
sourceReview.runtimeFindingConfirmed: Real Workerd now retains material_unavailable and invalid_material across close-before-send and safely signs with retained unopened material.

limits: Local native/Workerd and composed Gateway/SDK tests. No Cloudflare deployment or new hosted performance claim.
The Gateway exhaustion/transport matrix injects terminal causes at authenticated completion after real paired material consumption. Actual peer faults are tested separately.
Offline replay verifies signatures, circuit bytes, and retained assertions. It does not rerun network failures, authentication, or source review.
An absent or undecodable peer cause keeps a conservative failure category. No secret values or private bound-check results enter failure payloads.
